correctness.rationale: All vertices are cube indicators 1_S and spikes 1_S+(n-|S|)e_t. Their exact squared distances depend only on j=|S| and candidate center coordinates; spike distances convex in j, reducing maxima to j endpoints. In ell=1 direct formulas give equality at all cube indicators and the lone axis spike; in ell=2 only all-capped indicator and two axis spikes touch; for ell>=3 only the ell axis spikes touch, with strict inequalities elsewhere. Each proposed center is a weighted barycenter of actual contact vertices, proving minimax optimality and uniqueness by the squared-distance variance identity. A separate exact-rational vertex enumeration checked all 35 pairs (n,k), 3<=n<=9; all-contact classifications matched. Finite checks are not proof for arbitrary n.
